title: Experienced Data Engineer Consultant
description:
Experienced Data Engineer Consultant

  • Kampmannsgade 2, 1604 København, Denmark

  • Full-time

  • Contract type: Permanent contract

Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. 

  • Contract: Full-time 

  • Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

  • Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

  • Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. 

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

  • Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. 

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. 

  • Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

  • A relevant degree.

  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.

  • Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:

  • Migrated Novo's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

  • Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

  • Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere samt en sygeplejerske med fokus på kvalitet og undervisning
description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed til at skabe tryghed og udviklingsmuligheder for børn og unge? Hos MerVib søger vi både medarbejdere til det daglige arbejde på vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge og en sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinhåndtering og undervisning.

Vores tilgang
Et barn eller en ung kommer med erfaringer, interesser og håb – og ofte med andres fortællinger, der med tiden kan være blevet til faste sandheder om, hvem de er.

Hos MerVib er vi nysgerrige på barnets egen oplevelse: Hvad er vigtigt? Hvad lykkes? Og hvad kan vi voksne have overset?

På vores fire børne- og ungehjem arbejder vi for, at børn og unge oplever tryghed, tilhørsforhold og indflydelse på eget liv. Vores narrative tilgang præger, hvordan vi taler med og om børnene. Vi undersøger vores egne antagelser og får sammen med barnet øje på færdigheder, initiativer og håb. Barnets perspektiv er med til at forme vores støtte.

Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til Herrestrup og Grevinge
Du arbejder med tydelig struktur, professionel omsorg og relationer – både i fællesskaber og i individuelle opgaver med 1:1-støtte. Du tilpasser støtten til det enkelte barn og bidrager til en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag.

Vi søger dig der
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og erfaring med børn og unge i sårbare positioner.
  • Har viden om og erfaring med autisme, ADHD og omsorgssvigt.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for narrativ praksis og TEACCH.
  • Er nysgerrig på barnets perspektiv og kan tilpasse støtten inden for trygge, tydelige rammer.
  • Arbejder ud fra en Low Arousal-tilgang, tager ansvar, dokumenterer systematisk og er åben for faglig sparring.

Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet pædagog, socialpædagog, pædagogisk assistent, social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske, socialrådgiver, skolelærer, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut. Du kan også have en anden relevant socialfaglig, sundhedsfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse.

Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger med 12-timers dagvagter, 24-timers døgnvagter og weekendarbejde. Arbejdsstederne er vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge.

Sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet medicinhåndtering og undervisning
Som sygeplejerske skal du have et solidt fagligt og lovgivningsmæssigt fundament. Du kombinerer praktiske medicinopgaver med undervisning og kvalitetsudvikling og hjælper ledelsen og medarbejderne med at omsætte gældende regler til tydelige og forsvarlige arbejdsgange.

Dine opgaver omfatter at
  • Varetage medicinopgaver, herunder dispensering efter gældende ordinationer og instrukser.
  • Undervise og vejlede medarbejderne i medicinhåndtering og følge op på oplæring og kompetencer.
  • Gennemgå, opdatere og versionsstyre sundhedsfaglige instrukser i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og vejledninger samt følge op på, at de anvendes korrekt i hverdagen.
  • Omsætte faglige krav til brugbare arbejdsgange inden for blandt andet ansvar og kompetencer, journalføring, samtykke, hygiejne, utilsigtede hændelser og egenkontrol.
  • Indgå i det pædagogiske arbejde i husene i dagtimerne eller i weekender. Tilrettelæggelsen aftales med udgangspunkt i dine interesser og stillingens øvrige opgaver.

Vi søger dig der
  • Er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid erfaring med medicinhåndtering, dispensering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har solidt kendskab til relevant sundhedslovgivning, herunder regler om medicinhåndtering, journalføring, samtykke, tavshedspligt og delegation af sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Kender og kan anvende relevante vejledninger fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed og holder dig ajour med ændringer.
  • Kan underbygge din vejledning med gældende regler og faglige kilder og afklarer tvivlsspørgsmål, før du vejleder eller ændrer en instruks.
  • Kan skrive klare instrukser og gøre faglig viden anvendelig for medarbejdere med forskellige uddannelsesbaggrunde.
  • Kan undervise og vejlede præcist og praksisnært samt følge op på, at medarbejderne forstår deres opgaver, ansvar og kompetencegrænser.
  • Arbejder systematisk og selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Møder børn og unge med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiv.

Erfaring fra et børne- og ungehjem eller et andet socialt tilbud er en fordel.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med opgaver på MerVibs børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup, Grevinge og Jyderup. Vi har desuden undervisningslokaler i Herlev. Du skal være villig til at bruge egen bil.

Hos MerVib får du
Et arbejdsfællesskab med varme, engagement og høj faglig standard. Du introduceres til vores hverdag, værdier og metoder og deltager fra start med støtte fra kolleger og ledelse.

Vores årshjul rummer intern og ekstern undervisning samt faglige oplæg gennem hele året. Derudover får du tæt ledelsesmæssig sparring og supervision.

For begge stillingsprofiler gælder:
  • Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
  • Kørekort til almindelig bil (B) er et krav.
  • Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest før ansættelse.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed i spil hos MerVib.

Angiv tydeligt i din ansøgning, om du søger en medarbejderstilling i Herrestrup eller Grevinge eller stillingen som sygeplejerske med fokus på sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og undervisning.

Upload din ansøgning, CV og dit uddannelsesbevis via linket "Ansøg" her på siden.

Vil du høre mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Grevinge: Afdelingsleder Rikke Gjesing, telefon 92 90 42 24.
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Herrestrup: Afdelingsleder Nada Shouhani, telefon 92 90 42 16.

title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist - PCI On-Call Service
description:
The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer
The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements
You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
Or are willing to learn Danish
You can perform PCI procedures independently.
You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.

Desirable qualifications
Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.

About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:
6,000 invasive procedures annually
8,000 inpatient admissions annually
More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually

Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk

Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously.
Please include:
Curriculum Vitae (CV).
Letter of motivation
Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
List of publications, if applicable.

title: Software Architect for Research Cloud Services at the SDU eScience Center
description:
The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. 

Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud, which is the core of the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing.

We address stimulating new technological challenges. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals.

Job description:

The center is expanding its staff in one of its core areas: research cloud services. 

We seek an expert in the following areas:

  • Distributed and concurrent systems

  • SQL databases

  • Software development for HPC environments

  • Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes or OpenStack

  • Software development experience using Go, C or C++

  • Container and virtualization technology

Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience with Go, Kubernetes and distributed systems will be strongly preferred.

The successful candidate will become part of the cloud team at the eScience Center. Tasks under the user cloud team include, but are not limited to: Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems and services. Integrating with HPC schedulers such as Slurm and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes. Participating in the full feature lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architectural design to coding, automated testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring of production environments.

The cloud team at the eScience Center currently consists of four employees with long expertise in building cloud computing infrastructure, programming and software engineering. 

Required qualifications for the position:
 

  • Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description.

  • Strong background in Linux systems.

  • Programming skills (e.g. in Go, C, C++, bash, …).

  • Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, supporting software and consulting with scientists.

Other relevant qualifications (not required):

  • MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering.

  • Experience with DevOps practices (e.g. git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation).

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidates are expected to be on-site in Odense.

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the positions is 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible. Appointments are for full time positions for a limited time period of at least 1 year based on the candidate’s profile with the possibility of extension. 

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:

  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology

We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)





Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

title: Klinikassistent søges til deltidsvikariat i Viby J – hurtig opstart

Hvis du har erfaring fra en tandklinik og har mulighed for at starte hurtigt, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

title: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

  • Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

  • Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

  • Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

  • Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

  • Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

  • The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

  • Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

  • Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

  • Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges. 

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the job is as soon as possible, and it will be agreed with the successful candidate. The appointment is for a full-time permanent position.

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Prof. Director Claudio Pica

SDU eScience center

Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science

University of Southern Denmark

email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk

Application deadline 28 October 2026.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Entrepriseleder til tømrer afdeling
description:

Som entrepriseleder får du ansvaret for vores egenproduktion på en række spændende byggeprojekter. Du sikrer fremdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og sikkerhed og bliver en vigtig del af samarbejdet mellem byggeplads, projektledelse, bygherre og rådgivere.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

• Ledelse af tømrerentrepriser med ansvar for den daglige drift og planlægning.

• Koordinering af medarbejdere og interne ressourcer på byggepladsen.

• Opfølgning på tidsplaner, kvalitet og økonomi.

• Planlægning af materialeleverancer og logistik.

• Kvalitetssikring med støtte fra EMR’s interne KS-afdeling herunder DS1140.

• Ansvar for sikkerheden på pladsen med støtte fra EMR’s arbejdsmiljøorganisation.

Stillingen kan tilgås fra flere faglige baggrunde. Vi ser gerne, at du har en baggrund som tømrer, suppleret med en uddannelse som bygningskonstruktør, byggetekniker eller lignende. Det vigtigste er dog din erfaring med styring af tømrerentrepriser, dit engagement og dine samarbejdsevner.

• Tydelig, involverende og god til at skabe tillid.

• Målrettet, resultatorienteret og vedholdende.

• Motiverende, positiv og samarbejdsvillig.

• Ordholdende, loyal og løsningsorienteret.

• I stand til at læse og forstå tegninger og projektmateriale.

• Engageret i dine kolleger og de sjak, du har ansvaret for.

• Opmærksom på sikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø.

• En dygtig kommunikator med en tydelig, saglig og tillidsskabende kommunikationsstil.

EMR udfører projekter i hele Danmark i både fag-, hoved- og totalentrepriser. Du vil derfor indgå som en del af byggeledelsen på EMR’s egne projekter med ansvar for tømrerentreprisen, ligesom du vil stå i spidsen for selvstændige fagentrepriser for eksterne bygherrer og samarbejdspartnere.

title: Køkkenassistent til Restaurant Nordatlanten
description:
Køkkenassistent med ambitioner søges

Vil du være med til at forme det moderne nordatlantiske køkken?

Har du passion for gode råvarer, gastronomi og kreativ udvikling? Drømmer du om at arbejde et sted, hvor du ikke bare følger en menu, men faktisk får mulighed for at være med til at skabe den?

Restaurant Nordatlanten søger en køkkenassistent, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores køkken og være med på en spændende rejse, hvor vi udvikler restauranten, vores gastronomi og vores nordatlantiske profil.

Et køkken med plads til dine ideer

Restaurant Nordatlanten ligger på Odense Havn i Nordatlantisk Hus. Vores køkken tager udgangspunkt i Grønland, Island og Færøerne, men fortolket med et moderne, kreativt og gastronomisk blik. Vi arbejder med nordatlantiske råvarer, sæsoner og teknikker og henter samtidig inspiration fra det klassiske franske køkken.

Hos os får du mulighed for at:

  • være med til at udvikle nye retter og menuer

  • arbejde kreativt med nordatlantiske råvarer og smage

  • arbejde med sæsonens råvarer og mere bæredygtige løsninger

  • udvikle dig fagligt og personligt sammen med et engageret team

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • har erfaring i et køkken

  • brænder for gastronomi, gode råvarer og høj kvalitet

  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig og tænke nyt

  • kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

  • har lyst til at udforske nordatlantiske råvarer og smagsuniverser

  • tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • er en god kollega, der sætter pris på samarbejde og godt humør

  • er fleksibel i forhold til aften- og weekendarbejde

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har faglig stolthed, nysgerrighed og lyst til at være med til at skabe noget.

  

Mere end bare et køkken

Restaurant Nordatlanten er en del af Nordatlantisk Hus, hvor musik, kultur, udstillinger og events er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Det giver os en anderledes og inspirerende arbejdsplads, hvor der altid sker noget omkring restauranten.

Vi arbejder seriøst med gastronomien, men vi tror også på, at man skal kunne have det godt, mens man gør det.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med et kreativt køkken med plads til idéer og initiativ

  • Mulighed for at være med til at forme vores menuer og gastronomiske retning

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde og godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

  • En arbejdsplads med høje ambitioner og plads til at tænke nyt

Har du lyst til at være med?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af Restaurant Nordatlanten og være med til at udvikle vores køkken, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send ansøgning, CV og gerne et billede til Andrea på
andrea@restaurantnordatlanten.dk

Vi læser ansøgningerne løbende, og ansætter så snart vi finder den rigtige kandidat. Så send gerne din ansøgning allerede nu.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Lagermedarbejder til manuelt lagerpluk / Warehouse worker for manual stock picking
description:
Frisk og energisk kollega søges som lagermedarbejdere hos fødevare virksomhed.


Vi er en fødevare virksomhed som søger en kollega med lyst til at plukke og pakke varer til en bred vifte af restauratører på hele Sjælland.


Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og søger hele tiden nye arbejdsområder og har derfor brug for dygtige lagerfolk, der kan indgå i teams med mange forskellige kolleger.


Lagerarbejde i et mangfoldigt og sundt arbejdsmiljø
Som lagermedarbejder får du en tempofyldt hverdag med mange opgaver. Sammen med dine kolleger skal du sørge for, at de rigtige varer bliver klar til udlevering i det aftalte antal.


Opgaver

  • Plukke varer fra lageret 

  • Opfyldning

  • Varemodtagelse

  • Andre ad. hoc lageropgaver


Din udvikling i din stilling, samt muligheder for forbedringer er noget vi holder øjemed, så vi hele tiden kan skabe et fælles og godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor orden, kvalitet og automatisering er i fokus.


Engagement & fleksibilitet

title: 3 anlægsgartnere søges til virksomhed i vækst Skovbyholm Grønt is Hiring 3 skilled landscapers
description:
Skovbyholm Grønt er i vækst, og vi søger derfor 3 dygtige anlægsgartnere til vores team.

Vi arbejder med juletræsdyrkning, grøn vedligeholdelse og anlægsopgaver for både private og erhverv. Vi driver og vedligeholder mere end 220 hektar, og vi har derfor brug for flere medarbejdere til vores team.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil primært arbejde med juletræsdyrkning og vedligeholdelse af vores arealer. Opgaverne vil blandt andet være:

  1. Plantning og pleje af juletræer

  2. Formklipning og topskudsregulering

  3. Fældning og øvrigt arbejde i juletræskulturer

  4. Vedligeholdelse af grønne arealer

  5. Hækklipning og andre anlægsopgaver

  6. Betjening af maskiner og specialudstyr

  7. Andre praktiske opgaver efter behov og sæson

Vi søger dig, som

  1. Har erfaring som anlægsgartner, skovarbejder eller fra lignende praktisk arbejde

  2. Gerne har erfaring med juletræsdyrkning

  3. Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  4. Er fysisk robust og trives med udendørs arbejde

  5. Er mødestabil og fleksibel

  6. Kan arbejde i al slags vejr

  7. Har lyst til at blive en del af en virksomhed i udvikling

Erfaring med juletræsdyrkning er en fordel, men relevant praktisk erfaring inden for anlæg, skovbrug eller grøn vedligeholdelse kan også være relevant.

Vi tilbyder

  1. Fast arbejde i en virksomhed i vækst

  2. Varierede arbejdsopgaver

  3. Et aktivt og praktisk arbejdsmiljø

  4. Gode kollegaer

  5. Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for juletræsdyrkning og anlægsarbejde

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og CV.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

ENGLISH

 

3 Landscape Gardeners Wanted for Growing Company

Skovbyholm Grønt is growing, and we are looking for 3 skilled and motivated landscape gardeners to join our team.

We work with Christmas tree cultivation, green area maintenance and landscaping projects for both private and commercial customers. We manage and maintain more than 220 hectares, and we are therefore looking for additional employees to join our team.

Your responsibilities

Your main tasks will involve Christmas tree cultivation and maintenance of our green areas. Your duties will include:

  1. Planting and maintaining Christmas trees

  2. Shaping and pruning Christmas trees

  3. Leader shoot regulation

  4. Felling and other work in Christmas tree plantations

  5. Maintenance of green areas

  6. Hedge trimming and other landscaping tasks

  7. Operating machinery and specialised equipment

  8. Other practical and seasonal tasks as required

We are looking for someone who

  1. Has experience as a landscape gardener, forestry worker or in similar practical work

  2. Preferably has experience with Christmas tree cultivation

  3. Can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

  4. Is physically fit and enjoys working outdoors

  5. Is reliable and flexible

  6. Is comfortable working in all types of weather

  7. Would like to become part of a growing company

Experience with Christmas tree cultivation is an advantage, but relevant practical experience in landscaping, forestry or green area maintenance may also be considered.

We offer

  1. A position in a growing company

  2. Varied and practical work

  3. An active outdoor working environment

  4. Good colleagues

  5. Opportunities to develop your skills within Christmas tree cultivation and landscaping

Does this sound like a job for you? Send us your application and CV.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Om jobbet

Om Vivo Sales

Vivo Sales arbejder med mødebooking og direkte salg og har afdelinger i Vejle, Silkeborg og Aarhus. Vi er omkring 50 medarbejdere på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os går faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø hånd i hånd. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere trives, udvikler deres kompetencer og samtidig bliver en del af et socialt fællesskab.

  • Motiveres af at arbejde med salg og resultater

Praktisk information

title: Medarbejder til økonomiafdelingen (2-10 stillinger)
description:
Medarbejder til økonomiafdelingen (2-10 stillinger)

 I vores økonomiafdeling har vi en stor og vigtig opgave foran os. Vi har en del bilag og data, der har hobet sig op over en længere periode, som skal scannes, bogføres og struktureres. Da det er en omfattende opgave, søger vi et team på 2-10 medarbejdere, som kan arbejde tæt sammen, sparre med hinanden og løbende afløse hinanden i ferier og eksamensperioder.

Du vil blive en central del af teamet og få solid hands-on erfaring med klassiske regnskabsopgaver. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring i forvejen – vi sørger for en grundig oplæring i alle vores systemer, så du bliver klædt ordentligt på til opgaven. Der kan også være ad hoc opgaver som der ikke er beskrevet i opslaget.

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

·       Oprydning og digitalisering: Scanning af fysiske bilag/kvitteringer og organisering af historisk materiale. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Bogføring og kontrol: Kontering af omkostninger og medarbejderudlæg i e-conomic og Pleo. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Data- og systemarbejde: Indtastnings- og afstemningsarbejde i Excel og Dataløn. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Regnskab, fakturering og styring: Løbende assistance med debitor-/kreditorstyring, fakturering, fakturabehandling samt hjælp ved månedsafslutning. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Analyse og Excel/Libre: Ad hoc-opgaver inden for Excel-modellering. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Ad hoc-assistance: Koordinering via Outlook samt hjælp til praktisk planlægning og afholdelse af interne møder og træningssessioner. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Kommunikation: Formidling af virksomhedens interne regler og retningslinjer for udlæg og bilagshåndtering til resten af husets medarbejdere. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

 

Hvem er du?….måske

·       Du kan også være gang i et sabbatår.

·       Du kan også være ledig.

·       Du trives med rutineopgaver og motiveres af at få en stor oprydningsopgave i mål i fællesskab med dit team.

·       Du har mod på at lære systemer som e-conomic, Pleo, Dataløn og Outlook at kende (eller kender dem allerede).

·       Du arbejder struktureret, har et skarpt øje for detaljer og er en god holdspiller.

·       Du er serviceminded og har mod på at guide kolleger i organisationen omkring vores finansielle retningslinjer.

 

Hvad tilbyder vi?

·       Høj fleksibilitet: Vi tilpasser arbejdstiden efter dit studie eller efter dit behov, så der altid er plads til eksamensperioder og forelæsninger.

·       Grundig oplæring – vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele på forhånd.

·       Stærk erfaring på dit CV med udbredte og markedskendte systemer (Pleo, e-conomic, Dataløn).

·       En uformel arbejdsplads med et stærkt sammenhold i det nye team.

·       Timer: deltid eller fuldtid – det er op til dig

 

Arbejdssted: Skibby (4050 Frederikssund, Frederikssund Kommune / Region Hovedstaden)
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt.

 

 Ansøgning

Vi vil gerne vide, hvem du er – også ud over det, der står på dit CV. Send os derfor et meget, meget kort personlig ansøgning mærket:”studentermedhjælper”, der giver os et indtryk af dit potentiale og din personlighed. Du bestemmer helt selv formen, og du må meget gerne være kreativ!

Vedlæg dit CV samt din kreative ansøgning, og send det hele til josiah@curam.dk hurtigst muligt.

Vi tager løbende samtaler, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning!

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Josiah – Økonomiansvarlig på josiah@curam.dk.

Finance Department Staff (2–10 positions)

 

Our finance department faces a major and important task. A significant volume of vouchers, documents and data has accumulated over a long period and needs to be scanned, recorded, and organized. As this is a substantial undertaking, we are looking for a team of 2–10 employees who can work closely together, collaborate, and cover for one another during holidays and exam periods.

You will become a key part of the team and gain solid hands-on experience with standard accounting tasks. Prior experience is not required—we provide thorough training in all our systems to ensure you are well-prepared for the job. There may also be ad hoc tasks not specifically listed in this job posting.

 

Your primary tasks:

• Organization and digitization: Scanning physical vouchers/receipts and organizing historical records. We will assist you with this.

• Bookkeeping and verification: Coding expenses and employee reimbursements in e-conomic and Pleo. We will assist you with this.

• Data and system work: Data entry and reconciliation in Excel and Dataløn. We will assist you with this.

• Accounting, invoicing, and management: Ongoing assistance with accounts receivable/payable, invoicing, invoice processing, and month-end closing. We will assist you with this.

• Analysis and Excel/Libre: Ad hoc tasks involving Excel modeling. We will assist you with this.

• Ad hoc assistance: Coordination via Outlook and help with the practical planning and hosting of internal meetings and training sessions. We’ll help you with that.

• Communication: Communicating the company’s internal rules and guidelines regarding expenses and receipt handling to the rest of the staff. We’ll help you with that.

 

Who are you?… perhaps…

• You might be taking a gap year.

• You might be currently unemployed.

• You enjoy routine tasks and are motivated by successfully completing a major cleanup project together with your team.

• You work in a structured manner, have a keen eye for detail, and are a good team player.

• You are service-minded and comfortable guiding colleagues across the organization regarding our financial guidelines.

 

What do we offer?

• High flexibility: We tailor working hours to fit your studies or personal needs, ensuring there is always room for exam periods and lectures.

• Thorough training – we don’t expect you to know everything from day one.

• Valuable experience for your CV working with widely used, market-leading systems (Pleo, e-conomic, Dataløn).

• An informal workplace with a strong sense of team spirit. Location: Skibby (4050 Frederikssund, Frederikssund Municipality / Capital Region of Denmark)

• Hours: partime or full time – its up to you

Start date: As soon as possible.

 

 

Application

We would like to know who you are—beyond just what is on your CV. Please send us a very brief personal application marked "student assistant" that gives us an impression of your potential and personality. You are free to choose the format, and we encourage you to be creative!

Please attach your CV and your creative application, and send everything to josiah@curam.dk as soon as possible.

We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't hesitate to send your application!

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Josiah (Finance Manager) at josiah@curam.dk.

title: Associate Professor in Radiography
description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching Responsibilities
The position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and Expectations
The Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

  • Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

  • Strong research environments as a driving force for development

  • The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

  • A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

  • Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

  • Relevant clinical experience

  • Relevant experience in educational administration

  • A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

  • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan

  • a detailed description of research experience 

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Purchaser - Global Supply Chain
description:
Do you have experience with technical or project procurement in a larger international company? Would you like to help develop a global supply chain in an international project-driven organization? Then you may be the Purchaser we are looking for.

We are upgrading, servicing, and operating engine- and biomass-based power plants around the world. This creates a continuous need to source goods and services from subcontractors and ensure reliable transport for our customers.

For our Global Supply Chain department, we are looking for an outgoing and internationally minded colleague with commitment, determination, and a positive attitude. The department consists of 20 employees responsible for procurement, warehousing, and transport of goods and services.

BWSC – Ever better energy! 

Join us in our mission of building a world of sustainable energy and make a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

Your responsibilities

  • Support Project Procurement Managers with procurement tasks related to the execution of upgrading, service- and maintenance projects for engine and biomass power plants globally.
  • Obtain quotations from suppliers and place purchase orders within a defined area of responsibility.
  • Participate in broader departmental activities such as category management, supplier relationship development, negotiations, and implementation of supplier agreements.
  • Contribute to identifying and evaluating potential suppliers.
  • Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders.
  • Maintain and update various data, including supplier data, in the ERP system.
  • Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries and invoice approvals.
  • Assist with various development-oriented Global Supply Chain tasks within BWSC, including work instructions and new workflows.

The work is carried out in close collaboration with other departments in a dynamic and project-oriented organization. A flexible, cooperative, and positive attitude is therefore essential.

Desired Background and Qualifications

  • Experience within procurement, including purchase order placement and follow-up.
  • Completed education as an office assistant and/or relevant higher education qualification.
  • Minimum 3 years of practical experience with technical or project procurement.
  • Strong written and spoken English skills.
  • Good IT skills and experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Ability to work in a structured manner and meet deadlines.

What do we offer? 

At BWSC we build inspiring careers locally and internationally and give you access to a great network of possibilities. 

We offer you a position with great colleagues and the opportunity to bring your skills into play and grow professionally and personally. As a Purchaser at BWSC, you will receive a competitive starting salary and a strong reward package.

We offer an exciting position in a skilled, collaborative, and project-driven work environment, with opportunities for professional development and growth.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities, and an active Staff Club that organizes various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

Ready for a challenge?  

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Supply Chain Manager Anders S. A. Pedersen at asap@bwsc.dk.

BWSC is committed to promoting equality and diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age. Therefore, we do not recommend specifying age, etc., in the application. 

BWSC no longer receives or handles applications received via email due to GDPR requirements. In order for your application to be processed, you must submit your application via our online recruitment system. 

Get to know us even better on our website, www.bwsc.com, where you can learn more about our business, organization, project portfolio, and what we want to achieve at BWSC. 

About BWSC 

Burmeister & Wain Scandinavian Contractor A/S (BWSC) is a global power plant Operation & Maintenance and technical service provider with engineering expertise, enabling power plant owners to deliver cleaner and affordable energy. We are experts in servicing, upgrading, operating, and maintaining energy systems for diesel, natural gas, and renewable baseload power plants worldwide. We help our customers increase reliability and availability of energy production, improve efficiency and performance of their power plant, design and integrate future-proof technologies, and secure lower cost of maintenance.

Our people are at the core of everything we do and key to building strong relationships with our customers. We invest in our people and their wellbeing, supporting professional development and creating an environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth drive our continued success and growth as a company.
