title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in tumor cell biology
description:
About the position

A 100% 3-year Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in tumor cell biology is available in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Cancer Society.

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the research team and external partners at Oslo University Hospital, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor RUNX2, using cancer cell lines and PDX mouse tumor models, for various cell-based assays. The work involves in vivo setups and is expected to necessitate optimizations. 

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Responsibilities
  • Design and execute PDX prostate cancer studies evaluating the effect of microprotein modulation and peptide therapy, using cell biological approaches.
  • Design and perform cellular assays to test microprotein function and transcription factor modulation.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records and contribute to data analysis and interpretation.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms and prepare manuscripts for publication.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Applicants must hold a doctoral degree – PhD or equivalent. 
  • If a doctoral degree is not yet awarded, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing application date. Hiring will however be contingent on obtention of a doctoral degree. 
  • Solid knowledge of, and experience in, (cancer) cell biology.  
  • Experience in tumor biology.
  • Experience with cell culture and/or patient-derived xenograft (PDX) tumor models.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English. 

Relevant Qualifications

  • Experience with molecular biology and/or epigenetics is positive. 
  • Authorization to work with laboratory animals (rodents) (e.g. LAS301, FELASA C) is a strong advantage. If you do not have such authorization, you will be required to acquire it in the first part of your employment. 
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

title: PhD Research Fellow position in Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents for Defensive Cyber Operations
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents for Defensive Cyber Operations, available at the Digital Security Research Group within the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.05.2027. The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, which would involve 25% other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This depends on the applicant's qualifications and the department's current needs.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.


Project description

The position will investigate knowledge-grounded and neuro-symbolic approaches to large language models and agentic AI for defensive cyber operations. The PhD project will be carried out in close collaboration with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), including co-supervision from FFI with potential to connect the research to relevant cybersecurity and cyber-defence challenges.

The research will explore how heterogeneous cybersecurity intelligence and evidence sources, including telemetry and observations, can be transformed into structured cybersecurity knowledge, represented through semantic knowledge graphs, and combined with symbolic reasoning, modern language models, and autonomous agents to support security analysis, situational awareness, decision-making, and response. Particular emphasis will be placed on developing trustworthy, reliable, interpretable, and secure AI systems, including methods for grounding, reasoning, validation, and the control of agentic behaviour in security-critical environments. 

The security and robustness of LLM-based and agentic systems, including adversarial manipulation, uncertainty, provenance, and the validation of AI-generated decisions and actions, may also be explored as part of this position.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in cybersecurity, computer science (informatics), artificial intelligence, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Strong foundation in computer science or artificial intelligence/machine learning, with knowledge of cybersecurity or a demonstrated motivation to apply AI/ML in cybersecurity
  • Strong programming and software development skills, demonstrated through relevant projects, research, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates who have not yet completed their master’s degree must have completed all requirements for the degree by 31.12.2026.

The position will involve cooperation with stakeholders related to Norwegian national security, and candidates' suitability for this will also be taken into account.

Desired qualifications:

  • Knowledge of or experience with large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and related AI/ML methods
  • Knowledge of or experience with semantic technologies, including knowledge graphs, ontologies, knowledge representation, and/or symbolic reasoning
  • Knowledge of or experience with cybersecurity, particularly cybersecurity operations, security analysis, threat detection and response, cyber threat intelligence, or security automation
  • Knowledge of or interest in trustworthy and secure AI, including robustness, interpretability, validation, uncertainty, or the security of LLM-based and agentic systems
  • Previous research experience, for example, through a master’s thesis, scientific publication, research project, or equivalent work, is considered an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

  • Analytical, critical, and structured approach to research and problem-solving
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn, with the ability to adapt to new research questions, methods, and technologies

Be part of an exciting new chapter in the heart of Tønsberg!

Grandgården Mat og Vinhus is moving into beautiful new premises and opening Grand Café Tønsberg on 4 November! Located in a historic building in the city centre, the new restaurant will bring a European grand café atmosphere to life, with freshly prepared food, delicious tapas, great wines and warm hospitality.

We are looking for an experienced and passionate chef to join the kitchen team for a full-time assignment from 1 November to 19 December 2026.

title: PhD-fellowship
description:
About the position

A 3-year position as Ph.D. Research Fellow is available at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC), at the Department of Psychology, University of Oslo. The position will fit a motivated candidate with interest in memory and task-based functional imaging (fMRI). The primary objective of the position is to uncover the neural mechanisms underlying age-related memory change.

The research centre

The goal of LCBC is to understand differences and changes in brain and cognition across the entire lifespan, and to identify how brain function and cognition can be optimized. LCBC is an active, multidisciplinary research center with around 25 full-time staff members, including four professors, two researchers, several postdoctoral fellows and PhD candidates, chief and senior data engineers, full- and part-time research assistants, administrative support, and several affiliated international researchers. 

LCBC has excellent research infrastructure, including access to a 3T Siemens Prisma MRI scanner, PET and EEG facilities, and comprehensive neuropsychological and somatic testing facilities. English is the main working language at the center.

LCBC has secured several large grants, including four European Research Council (ERC) grants, a Horizon 2020 and a Horizon Europe grant, and several grants from the Research Council of Norway, the National Health Association of Norway, and the University of Oslo. In 2015, the group was designated “world-leading” and is one of only five such groups at the University of Oslo. More information is available on the LCBC website: https://www.lcbc.uio.no.


Project description

The Ph.D. fellow will work primarily on existing experimental fMRI data collected in the project "Lifespan Memory Imaging", funded by the Research Council of Norway. Using longitudinal imaging of brain activity and task-based connectivity, the project aims to predict early who will show memory decline and who will maintain good function as they age. This unique longitudinal fMRI dataset of episodic memory includes encoding and retrieval scans at both baseline and follow-up 6-8 years later. The project also leverages multimodal imaging data, including DTI, PET and ASL, and longitudinal cognitive and neuropsychological assessments. The position will focus specifically on the fMRI data to identify neural mechanisms underlying individual differences in age-related memory changes.


Your tasks
  • Process and analyze task-based fMRI data to estimate how memory processing changes throughout life.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including longitudinal cognitive assessments and PET imaging, genetic information and other types of data.
  • Write and publish scientific articles.
  • Collaborate extensively with the PI/supervisor, as well as other researchers at the center and collaborators of the center, including scientists in psychology, statistics, and genetics.
  • As the main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a Ph.D. degree, the research fellow must take part in the Faculty’s approved Ph.D. program.

Qualifications
  • Applicants must either hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in psychology, medicine, cognitive science, neuroscience, or a closely related field with an average grade of A or B. 
  • To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to a doctoral program is required. Read about admission and requirements to the Faculty's PhD program here: Applying for a PhD fellowship at the Faculty of Social Sciences.
  • Strong interest in cognitive processes and underlying brain mechanisms.
  • Applicants must have experience working with a high-level programming language such as MATLAB, Python, and/or R.
  • Good written and oral proficiency in English. If the person appointed does not have skills in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish at level A2 at the time of employment, we will offer Norwegian language courses with the aim of achieving Norwegian language skills at least this level.

The following will be considered advantages

  • Experience in using neuroimaging data to study brain function.
  • Experience with longitudinal analyses.
  • Experience with processing task-based fMRI data.
  • Experience with fMRI analytic methods including network metrics.
  • Experience with task-based connectivity methods (i.e. beta-series correlation or psychophysiological interaction [PPI]).
  • Good understanding of quantitative methods.
  • Experience with research in interdisciplinary environments.

Personal qualities

In the evaluation of applicants, emphasis will be placed on the following personal skills: 

  • Candidate’s good co-operative skills, and the ability to successfully join in academic collaboration.
  • Candidate’s professional and personal ability to work independently.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed, highly competent colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 558 000 - to 625 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Letter of application, 1-2 pages, explaining the motivation for applying.
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work.
  • Copies of educational certificates, publications/academic work (if any) that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee.
  • Names and contact details of at least two references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number).
  • International applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University’s grading system.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Psychology is one of seven units of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and has 75 permanent and 70 temporary members of scientific staff. Degrees are offered at bachelor and master level, plus a clinical training programme, and the PhD programme has 140 students.

title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.

Mobil: 982 95 163

title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.


About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 02.11.2026

title: Sjåfør og montør
description:
Ønsker du en fleksibel ekstrajobb der du kan jobbe når det passer deg?

Utleiekompaniet søker praktiske og pålitelige personer som kan hjelpe oss med montering, demontering, transport av utstyr til arrangementer og selskaper.

Vi har varierende arbeidsmengde gjennom året og trenger derfor ekstra mannskap som kan stille opp ved behov.

Stillingen innebærer tunge løft og arbeidet foregår for det meste utendørs eller i bil.

Vi har egne lastebiler og varebiler.

Arbeidstiden er normalt fra kl. 8.00 - 16.00. Kvelds- og helgejobbing forekommer.

Vi har ordnede arbeidsforhold. Opplæring vil bli gitt.

Krav til kompetanse

  • Snakke norsk eller engelsk

  • Førerkort kl. B

  • Erfaring som sjåfør på stor varebil (3500 kg)

Ønsket kompetanse

  • Henger BE

  • Truckførerbevis T2-T5

Personlige egenskaper

  • God arbeidsvilje

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Du må kunne utføre fysisk krevende arbeidsoppgaver, inkludert tunge løft.

  • Pålitelig, fleksibel og samarbeider godt i team

Vi søker ekstra medarbeidere til konkrete oppdrag og midlertidige arbeidstopper gjennom året, spesielt i forbindelse med arrangementer, festivaler og vår travle sommersesong.

Arbeidsmengden vil variere, og dette er tilkallingsarbeid uten garantert antall arbeidstimer. Du får tilbud om oppdrag når vi trenger ekstra hjelp, og står fritt til å takke ja eller nei.

I sommersesongen kan det også være aktuelt med egne tidsavgrensede arbeidsavtaler med opptil 100 % stilling i noen sammenhengende måneder.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Utleiekompaniet driver med utleie av partytelt, møbler, dekketøy og arrangementutstyr til festivaler, bryllup og alle typer events. Vi er en totalleverandør og vårt konsept er at man kan leie alt på et sted. Våre kunder holder til i hele østlandsområdet.

Utleiekompaniet har gjennom 30 år opparbeidet et godt renome og vi anser oss selv som en betydelig og seriøs aktør innen utleie. Pålitelighet og kvalitet er vårt varemerke og våre største kunder er eventbyråer, festivalarrangører og bryllupsverter. Vi er 6 heltidsansatte med 15 sesongarbeidere. Vi har stort lager og kontorer på Solgaard skog.

Vi søker flere fleksible sjåfører, montører og tilkallingshjelp.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

PhD project

This PhD position focuses on the fatigue performance of welded aluminium structures, with particular emphasis on understanding and improving fatigue-critical regions in the weldment. Welding introduces local variations in microstructure, mechanical properties, residual stresses and defects across the heat-affected zone (HAZ) and fusion zone, which can strongly influence fatigue crack initiation and propagation. The research will investigate how these local characteristics, together with weld geometry and the processing route of the substrates, govern fatigue performance and the transferability of fatigue assessment methods across different structural configurations.

The candidate will investigate strategies for fatigue-life enhancement through selected local post-weld heat treatments, mechanical treatments and in-situ thermo-mechanical modification techniques. Experimental work will include fatigue testing supported by relevant local characterization, XCT-based defect characterization and in-situ mechanical testing to study damage and crack evolution. The experimental findings will be combined with local, defect-based and fracture-mechanics-based fatigue prediction approaches to assess fatigue performance and treatment effectiveness. The research will also explore the implications of thickness-dependent behaviour and local weld properties for existing fatigue design approaches and potential future design recommendations.

The candidate will work in close collaboration with industrial partners and other researchers within FAST and will be responsible for reporting progress and delivering research outputs to the centre.

  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Investigate the fatigue behaviour and damage mechanisms of aluminium weldments, considering local variations in mechanical properties, microstructure, residual stresses, and weld-induced defects
  • Develop and evaluate local post-weld heat treatment and mechanical modification strategies to improve the properties and fatigue performance of critical weld regions
  • Investigate the applicability of in-situ thermal and mechanical modification techniques during welding for controlling local material properties and improving fatigue resistance
  • Perform fatigue testing combined with XCT-based defect characterization and in-situ mechanical testing to investigate fatigue crack initiation and evolution and their relationship with local material and geometrical features
  • Develop and validate local, defect-based and fracture-mechanics-based fatigue prediction approaches using the experimental findings, and assess their applicability to welded aluminium structures
  • Evaluate the implications of the obtained results for existing fatigue design approaches, particularly regarding material thickness, local weld properties, presence of post-consumer scrap, and potential recommendations for fatigue design standards
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

title: Supervisor Interior
description:
As a Supervisor Interior, you will be responsible for managing and coordinating interior installation activities onboard our projects.
The role involves supervising installation companies, ensuring compliance with HSE requirements, drawings, specifications, schedules, and quality standards, and monitoring daily progress throughout the installation process.

You will work closely with the Production Coordinator Interior and Department Manager Interior to plan and prioritize activities, coordinate interfaces with other disciplines, resolve installation challenges, and ensure that work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to project requirements. The position also includes quality control, progress reporting, inspections, and final handover of completed interior areas.
Duties and responsibilities

 

  • Plan, schedule, and prioritize work for installation companies.
  • Perform pre-checks of assigned work areas and identify potential conflicts with other systems.
  • Coordinate installation activities with other departments such as Hull, Paint, Electrical, Piping, and HVAC.
  • Provide work direction and guidance to installation companies.
  • Ensure work is completed according to quality requirements and planned schedules.
  • Participate in inspections with Class and/or Owners and ensure remarks are closed.
  • Support the Department Manager Interior and Production Coordinators Interior with budgeting and scheduling activities.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety requirements.
  • Verify availability of materials, equipment, drawings, and work areas before installation starts.
  • Manage contractor activities to maximize installation efficiency and minimize rework.
  • Monitor installer performance and provide guidance for improvement.
  • Develop and maintain lists of critical points and roadblocks for assigned areas.
  • Report installation progress and deviations on a weekly basis.
  • Report extra contractual activities and provide the required supporting documentation.
  • Manage the correction and closure of remarks and non-conformities.
  • Perform final inspections and handover of completed areas.

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Qualifications
  • Vocational education or equivalent technical background.
  • Experience within interior installation, shipbuilding, construction, or similar industries.
  • Knowledge of interior installation methods, materials, and equipment.
  • Ability to read and understand technical drawings and specifications.
  • Understanding of HSE requirements and safe working practices.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.Good planning, coordination, and reporting skills.

title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars across multiple markets. We are now entering a new phase of international growth, and the next generation of products and capabilities will be critical to our success.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication. Operating in remote environments with only a small solar panel as its energy source, the collar must reliably deliver virtual fencing and continuous livestock monitoring under strict energy and connectivity constraints.

We're looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer who wants to build products that operate in the real world and have a direct impact on sustainable agriculture and animal welfare.


Key responsibilities

  • Design and develop embedded software for next-generation livestock monitoring devices

  • Lead firmware development from concept through deployment and field validation

  • Build reliable low-power systems using cellular, GNSS, wireless communication, sensors, and on-device machine learning

  • Work closely with hardware, cloud, and product teams to bring new features from concept to field deployment

  • Drive software quality, architecture, and technical best practices across the platform


We believe you have

  • 5+ years of experience in embedded software development

  • Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing firmware for resource-constrained systems

  • Experience with modern embedded software architectures, development practices, and CI/CD

  • Experience building connected embedded systems and working with communication protocols

  • Solid understanding of low-power system design and energy-constrained devices

  • Experience with one or more of the following:

    • Cellular technologies (LTE-M, NB-IoT, 4G/5G)

    • GNSS

    • Bluetooth Low Energy and other wireless technologies

    • Sensor integration, signal processing, edge ML

    • Device management and OTA updates


We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments

  • Comfortable taking ownership and driving projects from idea to deployment

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering challenges

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams


We offer

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture

  • Challenging engineering problems in low-power, connected systems

  • Opportunity to shape industry-leading products during a period of international growth

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities

  • Competitive compensation and benefits


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Application deadline: August 16th 2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

title: EnkelBnb søker utleieforvalter i Trysil
description:
EnkelBnb søker utleieforvalter til vår nyoppstartede avdeling i Trysil! Du følger opp gjester før, under og etter opphold, koordinerer det praktiske rundt utleien og rykker ut ved behov. En fleksibel deltidsjobb der mesteparten av arbeidet gjøres digitalt.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi søker en person som bor i Trysil-området, og som er selvstendig, løsningsorientert og serviceinnstilt.

Førerkort og tilgang til bil anses som en fordel, ettersom deler av stillingen forutsetter fysisk oppmøte.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Stillingen består hovedsakelig av digital forvaltning. Det vil si at du som utleieforvalter har ansvar for kommunikasjon med gjester før, under og etter oppholdet, samt koordinering av det praktiske rundt utleien. Siden arbeidet i all hovedsak er digitalt, kan de fleste arbeidsoppgaver gjennomføres uavhengig av sted, og de fleste henvendelser lar seg løse uten fysisk oppmøte.

Den resterende delen av stillingen innebærer fysisk oppmøte ved behov - eksempelvis bistand til gjester på stedet eller befaring av nye eiendommer som skal inn i porteføljen.

Arbeidsmengden varierer gjennom året, og stillingen egner seg godt som en fleksibel deltidsjobb.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss kan du forvente varierte arbeidsoppgaver - alt fra digitalt arbeid i form av kommunikasjon med gjester og koordinering av renhold mellom gjesteoppholdene, til fysisk arbeid som befaring av nye eiendommer.

Hos oss kan du også forvente en god mengde fleksibilitet. Mesteparten av arbeidet kan du gjennomføre digitalt, noe som gir deg muligheten til å jobbe fra der det passer deg best.

Du kan også forvente en rettferdig og konkurransedyktig lønn. Vi er opptatt av at alle som jobber hos oss skal trives, føle mestring og få en lønn som gjenspeiler innsatsen de legger ned.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EnkelBnb er et forvaltningsselskap som bistår eiendomseiere med utleie av deres eiendom gjennom utleie på plattformer som Airbnb, Booking.com, Finn.no.

Vi ivaretar hele utleieprosessen på vegne av eiere som ikke selv har anledning til å håndtere utleien - herunder annonsering, gjestekommunikasjon, inn- og utsjekk, og løpende oppfølging.

Vi har drift i både Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim og Tromsø, og høsten 2026 etablerer vi oss i Trysil. I den forbindelse søker vi lokale utleieforvaltere som kan bistå med driften i Trysil.

title: Vi søker avdelingsleder til Innlandet
description:
Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og virksomhet i 13 land. Felles for oss alle er én viktig oppgave: å få folk trygt hjem hver dag. I Norge består vi av over 500 medarbeidere og leverer sikkerhetstjenester på vei og byggeplasser

Nå ser vi etter en engasjert avdelingsleder som vil ta ansvar ved avdelingen vår på Hamar. Stillingen er et vikariat med ønsket oppstart snarest og varighet til og med juni 2027, med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med å være i front, tør å gå nye veier og motiveres av å finne nye muligheter og spille andre gode. Som avdelingsleder får du ansvar for å lede, videreutvikle og styrke salgs- og prosjektorganisasjonen, med et tydelig fokus på mennesker, kunder og gode resultater.

 

Rollen som avdelingsleder

Som avdelingsleder får du ansvar for faglig og administrativ ledelse, organisering og drift av avdelingen. Du vil være tett på både medarbeidere, kunder og den daglige driften, samtidig som du får en sentral rolle i å utvikle avdelingen videre og sikre gode leveranser og resultater.

Dine viktigste ansvarsområder vil blant annet være:

  • Sikre god drift, kvalitet og lønnsomhet i prosjekter og leveranser
  • Videreutvikle relasjoner med eksisterende kunder og skape nye muligheter i markedet
  • Følge opp økonomi, budsjett, ressursplanlegging og resultater
  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere og arbeidsmiljøet i avdelingen
  • Bygge samarbeid på tvers av avdelinger og fagområder
  • Sørge for at sikkerhet alltid ligger til grunn for det vi gjør 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en trygg og tydelig leder som trives med å være tett på den daglige driften. Du har god forståelse for helheten, samtidig som du er opptatt av menneskene og det som skjer i avdelingen.

Du kommuniserer godt og bygger gode relasjoner, både internt og med kunder. Du bidrar til struktur og godt samarbeid i avdelingen, har et tydelig kundefokus og god forretningsforståelse.

Vi tror du vil lykkes i rollen dersom du har:

  • Relevant utdanning, gjerne innen tekniske fag eller ledelse
  • Ledererfaring – gjerne fra virksomhet innen bygg- og anleggsbransjen eller industri
  • Erfaring med prosjektledelse og drift
  • Erfaring med kundeoppfølging og relasjonsbygging
  • Førerkort klasse B (BE er ønskelig)
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig

 

Hva får du hos oss?

Hos oss får du en sentral lederrolle hvor du får være tett på både kolleger, kunder og drift. Du blir en del av et selskap med høye ambisjoner og dyktige kolleger som deler kunnskap og spiller hverandre gode.

Vi tilbyr: 

  • Muligheten til å utvikle en viktig avdeling i et selskap med sterke vekstambisjoner
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo og stor takhøyde
  • Muligheten til å bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi vil gjerne høre mer om hvem du er, erfaringen din og hvorfor du ønsker å bli en del av Ramudden. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

title: Avinor har startet boarding av teknologer – bli vår nye systemingeniør navigasjonssystemer!
employer: AVINOR AS AVD ASKER TEKNISK SENTER
description:
Du kjenner kanskje Avinor best fra når du skal ut på reise? Ikke så rart - Avinor har ansvaret for nesten 600 000 avganger og landinger, over 50 millioner passasjerer og cirka 50 000 overflygninger i norsk luftrom årlig. Vi utvikler selv og forvalter en kompleks infrastruktur som er avgjørende for den operasjonelle driften og en rekke digitale systemer som er essensielle gjennom hele «passasjerreisen» - blant annet avinor.no, passasjerapp, partnerappen «Community», innsjekkingssystemer, bagasjehåndtering, flytider, fjernstyrte tårn og andre tårnkontrolltjenester, flygeinformasjonstjenester, værobservasjonstjenester, cyber security og mye mer!

Teknologi og utvikling spiller i denne sammenhengen en avgjørende rolle, men ikke like mye som menneskene og miljøene bak! Nå styrker vi laget betydelig på teknologisiden. De riktige hodene, det gode samarbeidet mellom avdelinger og enheter er avgjørende for at alt spiller sammen på en effektiv og trygg måte – for både passasjerene og partnerne våre. Teknologiutvikling er sammen med bærekraft, et av Avinors viktigste strategiske satsingsområder fremover der menneskene og kompetansen vil være i fokus! 

Vil du bidra til sikker og effektiv luftfart i Norge? Avinor søker tre systemingeniører/fagspesialister til NAV/MET-seksjonen i Asker: to innen radionavigasjon og én innen meteorologi.

Vi forvalter og utvikler teknologi og tjenester som er avgjørende for sikker flytrafikk mellom og inn til norske lufthavner. Arbeidet skjer i tett samarbeid med leverandører, flygende personell, flygeledere og teknisk driftspersonell. De kommende årene skal vi videreutvikle og styrke kritisk navigasjons- og meteorologiinfrastruktur, og vi trenger flere dyktige kollegaer med på laget.

Avdelingen består av rundt ti spesialister innen navigasjon og meteorologi, med kompetanse på sensorer, radionavigasjon, radiotekniske analyser, måleteknikk og kontrollflyging. Har du teknisk interesse og erfaring innen ett eller flere av disse fagområdene, ønsker vi gjerne å høre fra deg.


Hva skal du jobbe med?

Navigasjon (NAV)
Du vil arbeide med systemer som VOR, DME, ILS, NDB og VDF. Oppgavene omfatter teknisk forvaltning, å inneha spesial-kompetanse for å finne ut av tekniske mysterier, lage rutiner for drift og vedlikehold, og videreutvikle fremtidige tjenester i samarbeide med leverandører.

Meteorologi (MET)
Du vil arbeide med systemer for måling av temperatur, lufttrykk, vind, skyer, skyhøyde og sikt. Oppgavene omfatter forvaltning, teknisk støtte, vedlikehold og utvikling av fremtidige løsninger

Felles for begge stillingene er at du vil:

  • Delta i prosjekter knyttet til implementering, oppgraderinger og reinvesteringer, så det er en fordel med noe kunnskap og erfaring innenfor prosjektledelse
  • Bidra som teknisk fagressurs i anskaffelser, utvikling av rammekontrakter og leverandøroppfølging
  • Delta ved testing, installasjon og idriftsetting av utstyr over hele Norge
  • Gi teknisk støtte og opplæring til lokalt driftspersonell
  • Bidra til sikker og stabil drift av kritiske tjenester for norsk luftfart
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er strukturert, løsningsorientert og samarbeider godt med andre. Samtidig trives du med å ta ansvar og arbeide selvstendig. Sikkerhet, kvalitet og etterlevelse av rutiner er en naturlig del av måten du jobber på.

Vi ser gjerne at du har:

  • Bachelor- eller mastergrad innen elektronikk, radio-teknikk, navigasjon, fjernmåling og sensorsystemer, anvendt matematikk eller tilsvarende
  • Arbeidserfaring/kompetanse innenfor overnevnte fagfelt
  • Kjennskap til Windows, Linux og kan utføre noe enklere programmering
  • Interesse for forvaltning, drift, samt testing og feilsøking av tekniske systemer
  • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Førerkort klasse B (gjerne også BE og/eller CE)

Det er i tillegg fint om du trives litt «hands on», og det er en fordel med erfaring fra installasjon, test, drift av elektroniske systemer, selv om hovedtyngden i arbeidsoppgavene vil ligge innenfor teknisk forvaltning. Erfaring fra luftfart er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning.

Stillingen innebærer noe reisevirksomhet, både til leverandører og til installasjons- og vedlikeholdsarbeid på lufthavner og andre lokasjoner.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø preget av tillit, samarbeid og høy kompetanse. Vi tilbyr blant annet:

  • Faglig spennende og samfunnskritiske arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode muligheter for læring, utvikling og karrierevekst
  • Strukturert opplæring og mentorordning
  • Konkurransedyktige lønns-, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Helseforsikring, full lønn ved sykdom og foreldrepermisjon samt tilgang til firmahytter
  • Fleksible arbeidsformer med mulighet for delvis hjemmekontor
  • Moderne arbeidsplass ved Avinors tekniske senter i Asker

Tilsetting forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk, uttømmende politiattest og sikkerhetsklarering, eller at slik klarering kan oppnås.

Er du klar for å bidra til fremtidens luftfart? Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg
