title: Reverse Supply Chain RTV Coordinator
description:
Shape the Future of Reverse Supply Chain Excellence at Axis

At Axis Communications, we don't just lead the global market in network video - we innovate, challenge boundaries, and set new standards. Our products and solutions are at the forefront of making the world smarter and safer. Success here is driven by our passionate and skilled employees, bold enough to think differently and deliver cutting-edge results.

Now, we're looking for a RTV (Return To Vendor) Coordinator to join and grow with our Reverse Supply Chain (RSC) team at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden. The Reverse Supply Chain team ensures excellent customer service by managing returns and repairs in the aftermarket, maintaining a smarter, safer and more sustainable world. This is a unique opportunity to make a powerful impact in a world-class organization.

Your Future Team - Supply Chain professionals with a strong sense of collaboration
You'll be joining a dynamic and talented team of RMA (Return Material Authorization) Supply and Reverse Logistics professionals, all working towards one common goal: delivering exceptional service by ensuring product availability at the right time and place. Our team operates with a strong sense of collaboration and cross-functional influence across Axis' supply chain, from strategy to execution. Together, we are committed to driving efficiency and optimizing processes for a smarter, safer, and more sustainable world.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will work with delivering and coordinating Axis' service offerings to our customers. Together with your team, you will be responsible for the efficient setup and execution of the reverse supply chain within a complex and dynamic environment.

Your work will involve close collaboration with a broad network of internal and external stakeholders. The role involves a significant amount of administrative work and requires a structured approach, high accuracy, and strong attention to detail. Your primary responsibilities will include:

Repair Flow & Order Management - Managing, coordinating and following up on repair and return orders from RMA partners to EMS (factory) providers and back, including order creation, shipment tracking, delivery follow-up, and resolution of logistics deviations.
Return Order Coordination - Creating, monitoring, and securing timely execution of return orders, ensuring accurate order status, proactive communication with stakeholders, and adherence to agreed lead times
ERP System Accuracy & Administration - Maintaining and administering accurate master data, and operational metrics within the ERP system.

However, this role goes far beyond supply and reverse flow planning. One part of your responsibility will be to participate but also drive continuous improvement initiatives - aimed at enhancing processes and collaboration across the organization.

Who You Are
We are looking for a self-driven individual with a positive mindset. You are a strong team player who also thrives when working independently, focusing and like to dig into numbers and managing your own tasks effectively.

You are energized by challenges, take initiative, and love to collaborate within a team. You enjoy working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and are motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact.

You are structured, adaptable, and capable of maintaining a detailed perspective, enabling you to make smart, efficient decisions in both the short and long term.

What We Expect:
Education within Supply Chain or a related field.
Experience in administrative and coordinating work
Good knowledge about Excel.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English & Swedish

What We Appreciate:
Experience with aftermarket operations or reverse logistics.
Experience in Supply Chain Management within a global organization.
Knowledge in ERP systems.

Why Axis? - A Culture That Values Impact and Growth
At Axis, you'll find more than just a job. You'll be part of a culture that rewards creativity, promotes continuous development, and values individual contribution. We offer a career in a fast-paced, global company that's constantly evolving, where you'll have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and see the direct impact of your work.

We want you to enjoy working with us, which is why we offer benefits such as morning "fika" every day, Friday cake, company bonus, wellness allowance, health insurance and your very own Axis bicycle - to name a few.

Ready to Drive Change?
This is your opportunity to join an industry leader and make a tangible difference. We are excited to hear from professionals who are ready to take ownership of their role and drive transformation in a global supply chain environment.

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

Submit your application latest by October 31st. For any questions, contact our recruiting manager Stefan Grönvall at

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

title: Consultant Psychiatrist – Welcome to Sweden!

Then this position within psychiatric outpatient care in Sweden could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Here, you will find a safe and welcoming workplace with broad multidisciplinary expertise, where they work together to make a real difference for their patients every day.

About the workplace

You will become part of a well-coordinated and skilled team consisting of doctors, psychologists, psychiatric nurses, social workers, occupational therapists, and medical secretaries who work closely together. The clinic also offers mobile services, increasing flexibility and accessibility for patients.

We regularly host students and trainees, which contributes to a dynamic and stimulating learning environment. Our culture is built on mutual respect, teamwork, and continuous improvement. They are also developing digital care solutions to complement traditional consultations.

Patient safety, quality, and a healthy work-life balance are always top priorities.

Your responsibilities

As a Consultant Psychiatrist, you will be responsible for the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients, in close collaboration with other professionals in the team. An important part of the role also involves cooperation with other healthcare providers and relevant authorities. You will meet patients with various degrees of mental illness, providing both independent assessments and collaborative treatment planning.

Qualifications

    Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
    Experience in outpatient psychiatry, addiction medicine, or insurance medicine is an advantage

    Confident, responsible, and professional approach
    Driver’s license (Category B) required

We are looking for someone who is committed to quality and teamwork, values a supportive environment, and is motivated by contributing to the development of modern psychiatric care.

Living and working in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, a well-functioning healthcare system, and a safe, family-friendly environment. Here, you can enjoy a healthy work-life balance, with time for nature, sports, and leisure. If you dream of a calmer pace of life, clean air, and easy access to forests, lakes, and outdoor activities – Sweden is the perfect place for you.

Benefits with Dignus Medical:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment.

    Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family.

Interested?

Contact me to learn more about the position, the recruitment process, and the relocation support we provide for doctors moving to Sweden. I look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Account Executive for Ecoroute
description:
Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!

Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.

In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.

With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.

About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.

You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.

Your responsibilities:

    

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

    

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

    

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

    

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

    

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

    

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

    

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

    

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

    

Hunter mentality.

    

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

    

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

    

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.

Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.

If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.

We are a part of Movement Software

Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.

Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.

title: Research Operations Intern
description:
Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.

As a Research Operations Intern, you'll provide hands-on support for our research studies. You'll keep things running smoothly day-to-day by troubleshooting devices, keeping inventory in order, and making sure every participant has a good experience from their first email to their last.

This is an entry-level role, ideal if you're early in your career and want to see how hardware trials at Natural Cycles work in practice. You don't need prior experience in clinical research. What matters most is that you're organized, reliable, and enjoy solving practical problems.

You'll work closely with the MAD (Medical Algorithm and Data) team and collaborate with Hardware, Finance, IT, and HR. Research and trials workload fluctuates, so we're looking for someone comfortable switching gears to collaborate with other teams if needed.

Please note that this is a one-year contract role based in the Stockholm area, with a start date in December.

What you will be doing

    

Troubleshoot: help participants solve device and app issues, test devices yourself, and figure out what went wrong when something doesn't work. Forward feedback to stakeholders in a structured and organized manner.

    

Look after devices and inventory: keep track of stock, prepare and ship devices and materials, and keep inventory records accurate and up to date.

    

Support participants by answering questions, scheduling calls when needed, and sending follow-up messages in a clear, professional, and friendly way.

    

Keep track of the details: check that signed documents are collected and stored in accordance with the internal protocol, monitor that participants are sharing data as expected, and flag anything that looks off.

    

Help with onboarding: schedule participants and prepare materials.

    

Run offboarding: guide participants through the end of a study, collect devices and materials, and coordinate with Finance so compensation is paid.

What skills and experience we think you have

    

You have a track record of taking responsibility and keeping things organized. This can come from a part-time job, volunteering, a student association, organizing events, coaching, or a similar role, paid or unpaid. Technical customer support role experience is a plus.

    

You're structured and like having systems: checklists, spreadsheets, and clear documentation.

    

You have strong attention to detail and easily spot small mistakes.

    

You enjoy troubleshooting and have the patience to help people who aren't comfortable with technology.

    

You explain things clearly and simply, both in writing and in conversation.

    

You can juggle several tasks at once without losing track.

    

You stay focused on priorities, even when plans change.

    

You're fully proficient in English, spoken and written.

    

You care about women's health and are curious about research.

    

You're comfortable with flexible scheduling, collaborating with multiple teams, and a varying workload.

    

You're based in the Stockholm area and available to start in December for a one-year contract.

What we offer

    

Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location.

    

Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment.

    

Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work.

    

Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value.

    

Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development.

Location

Most trial operations happen on-site, so being in the office regularly is essential. That said, when the work allows for occasional remote days, we’re glad to make use of that flexibility.

Sounds interesting?

If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

How to apply

To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies

title: Pulveroperatör - Hårdmetall
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vi söker nu en framåtsträvande operatör till vår pulvertillverkning på hårdmetallsfabriken.Här får du en central roll i att säkerställa effektiv produktion, samtidigt som du deltar i ett spännande förändringsarbete. Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team och bidra till framtidens hårdmetallsproduktion.



Bli en del av vårt teamVälkommen till pulvertillverkningen inom hårdmetallsfabriken hos Epiroc Drilling Tools. Här blir du en del av ett dedikerat team om tre personer, som tillsammans strävar efter att upprätthålla en högkvalitativ produktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.



Vi lägger stor vikt vid inkluderande och mångfaldsfrämjande värderingar. Kommunikation, öppenhet, nytänkande och personligt ansvar är centrala delar i vår arbetskultur. Vi stöttar varandra i vårt gemensamma uppdrag – att skapa en säker, hållbar och effektiv produktion med fokus på kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar.



Ditt uppdragSom operatör på pulvertillverkningen har du en viktig roll i produktionen där du ansvarar för drift och omställning av maskiner, operatörsunderhåll och kvalitetskontroller. Rollen innefattar självständigt arbete såväl som i grupp. Vi säkerställer att produkterna levereras med hög kvalitet och i rätt tid. Du identifierar och rapporterar avvikelser, samt bidrar aktivt till att kontinuerligt förbättra arbetsprocesserna tillsammans med ditt team.



Din profilVi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar och att driva på förändring. Din nyfikenhet, initiativförmåga och förmåga att strukturera och organisera är egenskaper vi värderar högt. Vi tror också att du trivs med att skapa och bibehålla relationer, och har lätt för att samarbeta effektivt med både ditt team och övriga funktioner inom produktionen och organisationen.



I den här rollen är det viktigt att du kan kommunicera på svenska i både tal och skrift.



Placering och övrigtDenna position är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige.Arbetstiderna är för närvarande förlagda till dagtid.

title: Control Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking to expand our Swedish engineering team with a junior software / control systems engineer who is motivated to grow into a complex and specialized technical environment.

The role is focused on control systems for our waterjets, where software, PLCs, and HMIs interact closely with mechanical and hydraulic systems. You will work alongside experienced engineers and gradually take on more responsibility as your understanding of the systems grows.

Today, our systems are primarily based on PLC and HMI platforms, but we are currently developing our next-generation control system, which will be PC-based, running Linux, with Qt-based displays. This provides an opportunity to work with both established technologies and modern software platforms.

This position is well suited for someone early in their career who is curious, structured, and eager to learn how real-world control systems are built, maintained, and supported over long lifecycles.

Key responsibilities

    Support development, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control software for industrial and marine systems.
    Work with PLC-based control systems, learning to read, understand, and modify existing code.
    Assist with configuration and development of HMI applications used in operational systems.
    Participate in testing and validation using development and simulation environments.
    Support investigation of field issues together with senior engineers.
    Collaborate with colleagues in Sweden and support internal teams when needed.
    Be part of the development of our next-generation control system.

Required qualifications

    A degree in software engineering, automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    Basic understanding of programming concepts and structured code.
    Interest in industrial control systems, automation, or embedded/real-time software.
    Willingness to work with existing systems and learn from legacy codebases.
    Ability to work in a structured and careful manner, especially in environments where reliability is critical.
    Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Preferred (but not required)

    Exposure to PLC programming (e.g. CODESYS or similar).
    Basic knowledge of industrial automation or control theory.
    Experience from internships, thesis work, or projects related to automation or embedded systems.
    Interest in systems that combine software, hardware, mechanics, and hydraulics.

Personal qualities

For this role, attitude and mindset are more important than specific tools. We are looking for someone who:

    Is curious and motivated to learn.
    Is patient and methodical when working with complex systems.
    Is comfortable asking questions and learning from more experienced colleagues.
    Takes responsibility and follows tasks through to completion.
    Enjoys understanding how systems work, not only writing new code.

What we offer

    The opportunity to develop deep competence in a specialized technical domain.
    A long-term role in a stable engineering environment in Sweden.
    Exposure to real-world systems with long lifecycles and high technical requirements.
    Opportunities to travel, as our customers are located around the globe.



The position is based at our head office in Uppsala and it is full time.

title: Geodata Specialist
description:
Exploration Geodata Specialist for Boliden Mines

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society’s access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future. What matters is how we produce them. Become part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Would you like to combine geoscience, data and technology to support the future of mineral exploration?

We are looking for an Exploration Geodata Specialist to help develop and maintain Boliden’s geoscientific data platform and support exploration teams across the organization. You will help ensure that Boliden’s geoscientific and exploration data remains reliable, accessible and useful over time. A key part of the assignment will be contributing to the implementation and further development of our new SQL-based geodata platform, QDB, across our exploration sites.

The position can be based at the Boliden office or at one of our sites, subject to agreement.

Who you will work with

You will be part of our Exploration Geodata team and collaborate with database geologists, geologists, geophysicists, GIS users, mine geologists, Boliden IT, the Assay & Data Quality group and Exploration management. You will also interact with software suppliers, consultants, developers and other technology partners.

This is a collaborative role where you will connect operational geoscience needs with practical and sustainable technical solutions.

What you will do

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Develop, improve and document SQL-based exploration database structures, views and validation logic
    Design workflows for geological, geophysical and spatial data
    Support the rollout and continued development of QDB
    Develop SQL scripts, import and export routines and automated workflows
    Integrate databases with GIS, modelling, reporting and analysis tools
    Support data quality, governance, QA/QC, metadata management and controlled access
    Translate the needs of geologists, geophysicists and Geodata users into practical system improvements
    Test new solutions and provide technical support, documentation and training material
    Collaborate with Geodata, Exploration, GIS users, IT and external suppliers
    Help ensure that exploration data is reliable, validated, traceable and accessible over time

What you bring

You enjoy working at the intersection of geoscience and technology. You approach complex information methodically and understand the importance of quality, traceability and long-term maintainability. You communicate clearly and can turn operational needs into practical technical solutions.

We believe you have

    A university degree or equivalent education in geology, geophysics, GIS, geodata management, database development, computer science or another relevant technical field
    Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
    A good understanding of geological or geophysical data, drillhole data and exploration workflows
    Practical experience with GIS and spatial data
    Programming or scripting skills
    The ability to develop, test and document database applications and automated workflows
    A structured, quality-focused and analytical approach
    Good written and spoken English
    Proficiency in the local language relevant to your workplace
    The ability to collaborate effectively with both technical specialists and operational users
    A valid European Category B driver’s license

It is an advantage if you have

    Experience integrating databases with GIS or geological modelling tools
    Experience with geodata management, exploration databases or geological and geophysical information
    Broad academic or professional experience covering both geoscience and data systems

We value potential and encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

Why work with us

At Boliden, care, courage and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a collaborative workplace where your contribution can have a direct impact on future generations. You will have the opportunity to work with geoscientific information that supports exploration activities across Boliden and to shape systems and workflows designed for long-term value.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us remain at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. We therefore encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Monica Johansson, monica.johansson@boliden.com, +46 70 201 21 67.

title: Co-Founder / CEO - Hybrid/Remote
description:
Co-Founder / CEO – Build the Next Big Tech Company

Start from day one – with capital, customers, and a team behind you

Company Description

This isn’t your typical company – we launch one new tech venture every month.

We develop the idea, validate customer demand, secure funding, and build the initial infrastructure – then we bring in a founder like you to step in as the CEO & co-founder from day one.

You won’t be starting alone. You’ll be building something new, bold, and scalable – but with a team of experienced operators, proven processes, and startup capital behind you.

Our team has founded and scaled companies like Realforce (120+ M ARR) and Minna Technologies (770M exit to Mastercard). Now we’re doing it again – over and over – and we’re looking for founders to build with us.

Our Model

What we provide:

A validated business idea and early customer interest

Startup capital and a full operational support team (tech, finance, legal, growth)

You as CEO & co-founder with equity from day one

A proven framework that creates profitable companies fast

Our Background & Track Record

We’ve launched multiple ventures already, and several became profitable within 12 months.

We select one founder per month to build with – and fully commit our resources to that venture.

This is not an accelerator, incubator, or passive investment – it’s co-building from scratch.

Our Team & Culture

We’re builders – not theorists.

We value speed, ownership, and clarity. Our studio is structured for execution, and we only work with people who have the grit and vision to drive something forward – fast.

You’ll work alongside operators in tech, design, GTM, legal and fundraising – and have the space to make the CEO role your own.

Requirement Profile – Who We're Looking For

We only work with three founder personas. Do you recognize yourself in one of them?

Founder Personas

1. The Growth Hacker

Commercially driven and thrives in sales and GTM

Built sales machines, funnels, teams or grown revenue 0–20M+

Ready to lead and build from scratch – with strong operational support

2. The Ex-Consultant

Background at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar

Wants to own a P&L, not just analyze it

Gets things done even in messy, imperfect conditions

Ready to lead a company, not just build decks

3. The Tech Builder

Senior developer or product builder who’s shipped real V1s

Can turn ideas into MVPs in weeks – not months

Has “unshakable conviction” about their ability to solve hard problems

Wants to be CEO and get commercial help from day one

Role Responsibilities

    Step in as CEO & co-founder of a new company
    Lead product development, GTM, hiring and growth
    Work directly with our team for support in sales, marketing, operations, finance, tech and legal
    Build and scale a business from 0 to funding, profitability, or beyond

Your Day-to-Day

    Operate as CEO of a brand-new venture
    Work closely with customers to validate and refine the product
    Collaborate with the team + other portfolio companies to execute and scale
    Recruit early team members
    Set goals and drive traction – fast

Qualifications & Experience

    You’ve built something before – a product, a sales pipeline, a company, or a team
    You’re comfortable with ambiguity and quick decision-making
    You have strong leadership instincts and can own your work
    You match one of our founder personas (Growth, Consulting, Tech)
    You have high “GSDQ” – Get Shit Done Quotient

Traits & Characteristics

    Entrepreneurial mindset
    Action-oriented and strategic thinker
    Clear communicator and team leader
    Quick learner with a hunger for building
    You don’t want a job – you want ownership

Career Growth & Benefits

    30% Equity as co-founder from day one
    Support from a full operational team
    Network, partners and potential investors provided
    High-impact role with startup-level freedom and real backing
    Proven model with real success stories



Compensation: 0 SEK base salary. Salary negotiated within 6 months. 30% equity as Co-Founder from day one.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Do you want to build modern software for critical logistics and transportation processes, and follow the customer all the way from need to result?

At IMI, we deliver SaaS-based solutions that support warehousing, transportation management, delivery visibility, and checkout experiences, used every day by leading retailers and logistics providers.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands the customer’s world, can turn needs into precise requirements, and takes responsibility for what ships. You will work the way modern teams do, with AI as a natural part of how software gets built.

About the Role

You will be a natural part of the customer’s whole journey, from onboarding new customers to supporting and maintaining existing ones. Most of your time will be spent designing, developing, and improving our products and integrations, while also supporting customers and colleagues when technical expertise is needed.

Unlike a traditional in-house development role, you will work directly with customers, particularly within integrations and technical onboarding in real-world logistics operations. You will work on new functionality, integrations, technical improvements, troubleshooting, and the continuous development of our solutions, in a cross-functional team with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and project managers.

You will work with modern SaaS platforms, cloud-native services, distributed integrations, and business-critical systems that process large volumes of transactions every day. Our solutions are built on technologies including .NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript, Azure, and modern web frameworks, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, maintainability, and continuous delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

    Translate customer and business needs into clear, testable specifications
    Design and develop new functionality and integrations between customer systems and our solutions, using AI tools and agents as part of your daily work, and own the quality of the result
    Develop and maintain business-critical software solutions, and troubleshoot issues in production together with customers and colleagues
    Assess business value, risk, and impact before and after changes
    Take part in customer onboarding, support, and maintenance as a technical specialist
    Contribute to product improvements, roadmap initiatives, and technical enhancements

Your Profile

We believe you enjoy combining software development with a customer-focused mindset. You are curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving technical challenges. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently, and are proactive in improving products, processes, and ways of working.

You can turn what you learn from customers into requirements that you or others can build and test against, and you balance business value, risk, and effort with long-term sustainability. You know what good looks like, and you can tell when code is not it, including code you did not write yourself. You are not afraid to ask for help when needed and appreciate knowledge sharing within a team environment.

We Believe You Have:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
    Strong ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements
    The ability to read, understand, and judge code, particularly in our stack (.NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript), including code you did not write yourself
    Practical experience developing with AI tools and agents, and a good sense of where they help and where they fail
    Several years of professional software development experience, including making independent technical decisions regarding architecture, quality, and risk
    The ability to get up to speed quickly in a complex domain
    Experience with integration development and customer-facing technical roles within a service-oriented organization
    Experience with cloud platforms and modern architectural patterns
    Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English

Preferred Qualifications:

    Experience with supply chain, logistics, transportation management, or warehouse management solutions
    Experience from a software product company
    Experience with Vue.js and Azure DevOps

The position is primarily based in Linköping and offers a hybrid working model.

Why IMI?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place To Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we provide a generous benefits package, including extra vacation days, a wellness allowance, and occupational pension contributions.

Application

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se

Apply now!

Automation and Electrical Systems Engineer
==========================================

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.



**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a small multidisciplinary team, iterate rapidly, and contribute to making a technically ambitious product reliable and scalable.



**Main responsibilities**

The applicant will have about 5 years of experience in electrical architecture, automation systems (PLC\-based, including industrial communication protocols), motor sizing and selection, generator sizing and integration, the dimensioning of components and integrated circuits (custom or off\-the\-shelf), along with a solid understanding of signal acquisition and processing.



**1\. Electrical Architecture**

* Design, prototype, and validate the overall electrical system comprising sensors, motors, generators, drivers, AC/AC and AC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers
* Grounding / earth connection experience
* Surge / lightning protection


**2\. Automation \& Communication Systems:**

* Implement PLC\-based automation (e.g., Beckhoff, Siemens etc.) and EtherCAT architectures.
* Integrate sensors and actuators via CAN, Modbus, EtherCAT, etc.
* Develop telemetry, data acquisition, and remote monitoring.


**3\. Motor Dimensioning, Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select motors for blade actuation and auxiliary systems based on torque, speed, duty cycle, environmental constraints and lifetime.
* Define drive architecture and requirements of power stage.
* Implement and validate motor control strategies (position, speed, torque control).
* Ensure compatibility with mechanical loads, power electronics, and safety constraints.


**4\. Safety, Standards \& Documentation:**

* Implement electrical safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with International Electrotechnical Commission standards (e.g., IEC 61400\).
* Ensure compliance with CE requirements
* Produce structured technical documentation.


**5\. Grid Integration:**

* Manage grid connection, anti\-islanding, synchronization, relays, and protection.
* Size HV/MV cables and design electrical cabinets.


**6\. Generator Selection \& Control:**

* Dimension and select the generator technology based on power rating, speed range, efficiency, and grid requirements.
* Define electrical interface and integration with rectifier/inverter stages.
* Implement and validate generator\-side control strategies (MPPT, torque control, speed regulation, power optimization).




**Nice to have**

**1\. Experience with outdoor equipment**, industrial machinery or safety\-critical systems.

**2\. Experience with energy systems** (wind power, hydro power, …)

**3\. PCB Design** (schematic and layout to bring\-up and EMC considerations)

**4\. Firmware Development** (drivers, communication protocols)



**Your profile**

* About 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, power electronics or industrial automation.
* Comfortable working autonomously in a small engineering team.
* Team player
* Experience working on systems exposed to real\-world constraints (e.g. noise, EMC, environmental conditions, reliability, safety).
* Comfortable managing engineering partners and technical procurement activities, including identifying and selecting suppliers, defining technical specifications, reviewing datasheets and validation documents, coordinating technical exchanges, and supporting supplier qualification.
* Produce structured technical documentation
* Elaborate systematic testing and verification
* Clear and pro\-active communication within the team; provide structured reporting on progress and issues, expresses technical needs early.
* Well\-organized with strong planning skills, able to define clear steps, anticipate resource.

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Schinznach im Kanton Aargau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern auf Entzugsstationen, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind. - Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Hinwil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Bezugspflege.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Hinwil

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Bezugspflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Hinwil

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Hinwil liegt im Zürcher Oberland und überzeugt Sie als Arbeitsort durch seine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkter S-Bahn-Verbindung nach Zürich. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Umfeld mit guter Infrastruktur, zahlreichen Arbeitsplätzen und einer hohen Lebensqualität. Die Nähe zur Natur sowie die Kombination aus urbanem Angebot und ländlichem Charakter machen Hinwil zu einem beliebten Arbeitsstandort für Pendler und ansässige Unternehmen.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Hinwil

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Bezugspflege

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Hinwil im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern mit Diplom HF/FH, insbesondere für Positionen in der Bezugspflege mit 80-100% Pensum. Aufgrund des Fachkräftemangels bieten sich Ihnen hervorragende Chancen, schnell eine attraktive Stelle zu finden und dabei von einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt zu profitieren. Als spezialisierter Personalvermittler kennt iPersonal die lokalen Anforderungen und Arbeitgeber in der Region und unterstützt Sie durch gezielte Vermittlung sowie individuelle Beratung beim nahtlosen Berufseinstieg. So reduzieren Sie Ihre Suchzeit erheblich und finden rasch eine Position, die Ihren Vorstellungen entspricht.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Hinwil

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Bezugspflege in Hinwil wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

MILA ist der externe Finance \& Operations Partner für Schweizer KMU. Digital, effizient und immer auf Augenhöhe. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden schaffen, wir haben den Rest. Beim Lohn soll dieser Rest bald bei dir liegen.

* Du verarbeitest die monatlichen Löhne deiner Mandanten, inklusive Quellensteuer.

Was du mitbringst
-----------------

* Du hast eine kaufmännische Grundbildung und eine Weiterbildung als Sachbearbeiter:in Lohnadministration oder Personalwesen. Ein Fachausweis ist ein Plus.

* **Remote:** Du arbeitest dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Leitung Tageszentrum

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Leitung Tageszentrum in Berikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Berikon im Kanton Aargau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach erfahrenen Pflegefachpersonen mit Leitungskompetenzen in Tageszentren, da der demografische Wandel den Personalbedarf kontinuierlich steigert. Sie haben als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH mit Führungsqualifikationen hervorragende Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können von wettbewerbsfähigen Löhnen sowie modernen Arbeitsbedingungen profitieren. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler durch fundierte Marktkenntnis, passende Stellenangebote und individuelle Beratung, um Ihnen den nahtlosen Einstieg in eine erfüllende Führungsposition zu erleichtern.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Berikon

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Leitung Tageszentrum in Berikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

**Qui sommes\-nous ?**

Alpenda est une Entreprise Totale et Générale dont le siège social est à Tolochenaz (VD). L’entreprise compte plus 200 collaborateurs et cumule 80 ans d’expérience en Suisse romande et dans le canton de Berne. Spécialisée dans la conception et la réalisation de logements et d’ouvrages fonctionnels (bureaux, manufactures, centres commerciaux, hôtels, hôpitaux..) Alpenda possède également une expertise reconnue dans la rénovation, l’assainissement et la transformation de bâtiments existants, ainsi que dans la réalisation de projets de prestige. Soucieuse de l’éthique, de l’environnement et de la qualité de vie, Alpenda s’engage à concevoir et construire des ouvrages performants, durables et respectueux des femmes et des hommes qui y vivent. Alpenda est la filiale suisse du Groupe DEMATHIEU BARD.

Chef de projet technique H/F

**Vos responsabilités et missions :**

* Vous pilotez une équipe complète de spécialistes pour établir l’offre la plus pertinente et attractive.
* Vous animez les échanges avec les partenaires externes (mandataires, fournisseurs, prestataires).
* Vous êtes le relais entre la direction technique et l’équipe commerciale.
* Vous participez pleinement à la recherche d’optimisations techniques et économiques.
* Vous êtes le garant de la conformité de l’étude, en contrôlant le respect des normes et des exigences du cahier des charges, en collaboration avec l’équipe de spécialistes.
* Vous présentez le travail de votre équipe à la direction de l’entreprise, détaillant les hypothèses, les idées et les éléments de contrôle des estimations.
* Avec votre équipe Direction Technique et en lien avec l’équipe commerciale, vous rédigez toute la partie technique et financière de l’offre finale remise.
* Vous participez pleinement aux oraux de présentation de votre offre en assurant la présentation des aspects techniques et en répondant aux questions sur ces sujets.
* Vous assurez le suivi jusqu’à une potentielle adjudication, participez à l’élaboration du contrat et transférer le dossier à l’équipe Travaux




**Votre environnement de travail :**

La direction technique et achats d’Alpenda est un véritable pilier de notre entreprise. Composée d’une trentaine d'experts, d'ingénieurs et de chefs de projets hautement qualifiés, elle est garante de notre savoir\-faire et incarne notre engagement envers l'innovation et la durabilité.

En tant que Chef\-fe de projet technique, vous aurez pour mission de garantir l’excellence technique, la cohérence globale et la maîtrise des choix constructifs sur l’ensemble des projets menés en entreprise totale. Référent technique interne, vous soutenez les équipes Études, anticipez les risques, validez les solutions techniques et assurez le respect des standards élevés d’Alpenda.




**Pourquoi pas vous ?**

* Vous êtes diplômé d'un Bachelor en économie de la construction, d’un diplôme d’ingénieur EPF/ETH/HES ou d'un titre jugé équivalent et possédez une première expérience réussie en tant qu’ingénieur étude ?
* Vous êtes un généraliste de la construction et êtes capable d'aborder n'importe quelle problématique technique du bâtiment ?
* Vous êtes organisé, rapide et flexible, à l’écoute des innovations techniques ?
* Vous avez une bonne gestion du stress, et une culture du résultat ?
* L’esprit d’équipe est une de vos principales qualités et vous êtes un coach naturel ?
* Vous parlez couramment français, des connaissances de l’anglais et/ou de l’allemand un atout ?
* Vos connaissances des modes constructifs ainsi que des prix de construction en Suisse sont un atout prépondérant ?




Vous avez envie de relever de nouveaux défis ? Nos équipes n’attendent plus que vous !

Conseils aux candidats
----------------------

Pour maximiser vos chances de succès :

* Soyez curieux,
* N’hésitez pas à consulter les profils LinkedIn de vos futurs interlocuteurs.
* Illustrez votre candidature en mettant en avant vos réalisations par des exemples concrets.
* Exprimez votre personnalité, votre adaptabilité, votre esprit innovant et vos idées audacieuses.
* Partagez votre passion pour le bâtiment !
* DEMATHIEU BARD recherche des personnes qui osent sortir de leur zone de confort. A vous de construire votre avenir !




Process de recrutement
----------------------
> À réception de votre candidature, notre service recrutement l’étudiera dans les meilleurs délais. Déroulement :

* Un premier échange avec le Chargé de recrutement ou Responsable Ressources Humaines en charge du périmètre concerné par cette annonce.
* Rencontres avec un ou plusieurs opérationnels dont votre futur responsable hiérarchique, nous permettant de nous projeter ensemble et de confirmer une potentielle collaboration.
* Intention d’engagement.







**Ce que nous vous proposons :**

* Un environnement de travail diversifié et stimulant où chaque collaborateur peut s’épanouir professionnellement.
* Des conditions attractives comprenant un système de rémunération compétitif ainsi que des avantages sociaux intéressants.
* Un investissement dans le développement professionnel de nos collaborateurs par des formations de base et continues.
* Des espaces de travail modernes, dynamiques et inspirants, que ce soit dans nos bureaux ou sur nos chantiers.
* Des moments conviviaux, journées d’entreprise pour renforcer le partage et la cohésion entre les équipes.
* Une expérience à l’international \#Suisse

description: Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL The Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL is part of the ETH Domain. Approximately 600 people work on the sustainable use and protection of the environment and on the handling of natural hazards. The Research Unit Forest and Soil Ecology assesses the impact of climate change and management on forests and their soils. The group Critical Zone dynamics is offering a \*\*two\\-year position\*\* as Technician in Biogeosciences 50% (f/m/d) You will work within the recently funded SNSF project FIRE ("Fire Impacts on the Response of terrestrial Ecosystems"). This project investigates how wildfires affect carbon cycling and transit times at the landscape scale, particularly in the deeper unsaturated zone and in groundwater, and over longer periods of time. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team of collaborators based in Switzerland and the USA, and support the team in conducting geochemical analysis (particularly radiocarbon) on environmental samples from recently burned landscapes in the USA. Your main tasks will involve preparation of a range of sample types (gaseous, aqueous, and solid) for stable carbon isotope and radiocarbon analysis. This will be done in collaboration with our partners at the Laboratory for Ion Beam Physics at ETH Zurich, where you will also frequently work. Processing of samples for other types of analysis, , major ion concentrations, general chemistry, will also be part of your duties. You will support and train a PhD candidate and guests from our partner universities in the USA in laboratory procedures. Moreover, you will also assist the team with administrative and logistical duties, , the shipping of samples and materials to and from field sites in the USA. You preferably hold a Master's degree in environmental or earth sciences or related disciplines, and have demonstrated experience with mass spectrometric methods for geochemical analysis and/or radiocarbon methods. If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

**Role**

As a Principal Data Architect, you will provide strategic guidance and long\-term vision across data and AI, working closely with our clients to solve complex data challenges, from platform modernisation and governance to real\-time architectures and AI operationalization. You will design and deliver data architectures and strategies that are fit for purpose, balancing technical rigour with business value, while bringing the curiosity and conviction to challenge conventional thinking and push the boundaries of what data and AI can do for our clients.

**How you’ll make impact**

* **Trusted Advisor:** You guide our clients towards successful solutions to their data challenges. You'll lead design sessions, architecture reviews, proof\-of\-concept projects and evaluation of new data technologies and vendors.

* **Thought Leadership \& Consulting:** You promote understanding of AI and data technologies, share your knowledge both internally and externally, and invest in growing the talent around you.


**What’s important to us**

* You bring deep expertise in AI and data solutions, along with a nuanced understanding of their possibilities and limitations.

You make confident decisions and can clearly explain your reasoning, balancing technical rigour with pragmatism to keep delivery on track.
* Excellent communication skills on management level as well as with technical experts in both German and English are essential.
* You hold a technical degree in Computer Science, or a comparable field.

Nous mettons l’humain au cœur de nos activités : après tout, nos ordinateurs peuvent résoudre des problèmes, mais ils ne savent toujours pas faire un bon café !





**Technicien Support IT N1**

Aujourd'hui nous recherchons un Technicien Support N1 pour rejoindre l'équipe ServiceDesk de notre client à Lausanne.







Il s'agit d'un poste avec durée de plus de 4 ans, avec un démarrage au 1er mars 2027\.







Votre rôle:



* Accueillir, réceptionner et qualifier les sollicitations des utilisateurs via les différents canaux : téléphone, portail self\-service, e\-mail et guichet d'accueil physique.
* Créer, catégoriser, documenter et prioriser l'ensemble des tickets d'incidents et de demandes de service dans l'outil de gestion (Jira Service Management).
* Réaliser le diagnostic de premier niveau et assurer la résolution autonome des incidents et demandes relevant de votre périmètre d'intervention (objectif de First Level Resolution élevé).
* Prendre en charge les demandes de service courantes : réinitialisation de mots de passe, déblocage de comptes, attributions de droits d'accès et assistance bureautique.
* Gérer le matériel informatique du parc : préparation et attribution des PC de pool, remise d'équipements en stock, assistance sur la téléphonie et gestion des cartes SIM.
* Assurer le support de base sur les terminaux mobiles et tablettes métier (environnement Android).
* Traiter les incidents de sécurité de premier niveau : qualification des alertes antivirus et traitement des signalements de phishing (Hoxhunt).
* Escalader et transférer les tickets non résolus vers les équipes d'expertise de niveau 2/3 en fournissant l'ensemble des éléments d'analyse nécessaires.
* Rédiger et maintenir à jour la documentation opérationnelle (fiches de procédures internes et guides d'utilisation à destination des collaborateurs).
* Respecter rigoureusement les engagements de niveaux de service (SLA) et contribuer à la satisfaction globale des utilisateurs finaux.






Le profil recherché:



* Formation initiale en informatique (CFC informatique, titre équivalent ou expérience avérée en centre de services / support utilisateurs).
* Expérience probante sur un poste similaire de technicien support de niveau 1 ou Service Desk en environnement d'entreprise.
* Solides compétences techniques sur les environnements Windows (postes de travail, Active Directory) et la suite bureautique Microsoft 365 / Teams.
* Bonnes notions d'assistance sur les terminaux mobiles Android et smartphones d'entreprise.
* Connaissance pratique de base de SAP GUI (navigation et transactions standards).
* Maîtrise opérationnelle d'un outil de gestion de tickets (idéalement Jira Service Management) et sensibilisation aux bonnes pratiques ITIL.
* Excellent sens du service, écoute active, diplomatie et aisance relationnelle pour la tenue du guichet d'accueil physique.
* Rigueur méthodologique, esprit de synthèse, réactivité et capacité d'adaptation au sein d'une équipe sur site.






Les étapes du processus de recrutement chez API :



* Engageons la conversation ! Pour commencer, nous souhaitons découvrir qui vous êtes : votre parcours, vos intérêts et vos aspirations. Cette première prise de contact nous permettra de mieux vous connaître.
* Ensuite, approfondissons ! Vous aurez l’occasion de rencontrer nos Business Managers qui vous parleront de la vie de consultant chez API. Ce sera le moment idéal pour découvrir les projets qui retiennent votre attention en fonction de vos ambitions !
* Concrétisons ! Une fois l’adéquation entre vos ambitions, vos compétences et le projet établie, l’aventure ensemble peut commencer !

Automation and Electrical Systems Engineer
==========================================

**About us**

Windworks develops actively controlled vertical\-axis wind turbines for clean, local and affordable energy production. We pioneered an advanced technology control system for wind turbine blades, using sensors, control software and proprietary actuation technology to dramatically increase our machine performances .

Our turbines are designed for on\-site power generation in commercial, industrial and community applications, especially where conventional wind turbines are difficult to deploy.

Based in the Lausanne area, Windworks combines aerodynamic research, experimental testing, mechanical design, electronics, control and field validation to bring a new generation of wind turbines to market.



**Role description**

You will participate to the definition, integration and validation of the turbine’s electrical architecture, contributing directly to a technology that must perform reliably over time in harsh conditions. This role offers a high level of ownership and impact, with the opportunity to shape key parts of the system architecture and see your work move quickly from concept to testing and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a small multidisciplinary team, iterate rapidly, and contribute to making a technically ambitious product reliable and scalable.



**Main responsibilities**

**1\. Electrical Architecture**

For one of our clients a leading international company based in **Geneva**, we are looking for a

#### Digital \& Motion Designer M/F

6 month temporary assignment

Full\-time position

Description du poste
--------------------

* Concept and ideate: Develop creative ideas and visual approaches that translate brand strategies and communication objectives into engaging digital content.
* Create motion\-led storytelling: Design and produce animations and short\-form videos that clearly communicate product benefits, brand messages, and brand personality.
* Design across digital touchpoints: Create digital banners, sponsored brand displays, social and e\-commerce assets, rich content, and other digital campaign materials.

* A degree in graphic design, motion design, animation, visual communication, or a related field.

* Understanding of platform\-specific requirements, including aspect ratios, safe zones, file sizes, codecs, compression, and export settings.
* Ability to design for mobile\-first viewing, sound\-off consumption, legibility, and accessibility.

**Tools**

* Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing and campaign cutdowns.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for asset creation, image editing, and digital design.
* Familiarity with Adobe Media Encoder and efficient rendering, versioning, and delivery workflows.
* Strong proficiency in diverse AI tools.
* Preferred but not mandatory familiarity with HTML5 banner production or rich\-media tools such as Google Web Designer.
* Preferred but not mandatory basic 3D design and animation skills using Cinema 4D or Blender.

**Ways of working**

* Creative curiosity paired with a hands\-on, solution\-oriented approach.
* Ability to explain creative choices clearly and respond constructively to feedback.
* Strong collaboration skills and confidence working with both design and non\-design stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with the agility to handle shifting priorities.
* Ownership of quality from initial concept through final export, balancing speed with meticulous execution.

E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead
=================

Location: Basel, Switzerland (project scope includes Portsmouth, UK) Start Date: 1 November 2026 Contract Duration: Until 31 October 2027 Lead end\-to\-end computerised system validation and qualification for an innovative manufacturing data pl

E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead
=================

### description:

We are seeking an experienced E2E CSV/C\&Q Lead to take ownership of the end\-to\-end validation and qualification strategy for a strategic Operations Data Hub (ODH) programme.

The position covers integrated manufacturing systems, IT/OT interfaces, infrastructure, semantic data models, data products and operational applications. You will collaborate with Engineering, Automation, Quality, IT/OT and business stakeholders to ensure that solutions meet regulatory, quality and data integrity requirements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Define, implement and maintain an integrated, risk\-based Computerised System Validation (CSV) and Commissioning \& Qualification (C\&Q) strategy.
* Establish validation boundaries, intended use, GxP classifications and appropriate controls across the manufacturing data platform.
* Develop modular qualification frameworks, documentation standards and reusable validation approaches for future implementations.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end validation execution, including requirements traceability, testing, documentation and release readiness.
* Define validation approaches for operational applications supporting batch traceability, process monitoring and customer data sharing.
* Evaluate data integrity, data lineage, interoperability and auditability across integrated manufacturing systems.
* Ensure alignment with ALCOA\+ principles and relevant GMP requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate validation documentation for independent Quality review and approval.
* Define supplier assurance strategies, including the use of vendor testing and previously qualified components.
* Ensure that validated\-state maintenance requirements are incorporated into operational support processes.
* Develop qualification templates, implementation prerequisites and resource, cost and timeline estimates for future site rollouts.
* Facilitate cross\-functional risk assessments, manage validation dependencies and escalate programme\-level compliance risks.
* Support release readiness assessments and coordinate with business and Quality stakeholders throughout implementation.


### About the customer:

Our client is an internationally established organisation within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector, specialising in complex, highly regulated manufacturing operations. As part of its digital transformation initiatives, the organisation is implementing advanced manufacturing data solutions to improve connectivity, traceability and operational efficiency across production environments.

### Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, IT, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Quality Management or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading end\-to\-end CSV/C\&Q activities for integrated IT/OT systems, manufacturing data platforms or regulated operational applications.
* Strong understanding of GMP, CSV/CSA, Commissioning \& Qualification and risk\-based validation methodologies.
* Practical experience managing change control, deviations, CAPA and maintenance of the validated state.
* Solid expertise in validation documentation, requirements traceability, testing strategies and supplier assurance.

OT Integration Delivery Lead

OT Integration Delivery Lead
============================

### description:

We are looking for an experienced OT Integration Delivery Lead to oversee the delivery of operational technology integrations and plant\-side applications as part of a strategic Operations Data Hub (ODH) programme.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated technical workstream, collaborating with automation teams, IT stakeholders, engineering partners and external vendors to deliver secure, scalable and maintainable manufacturing integrations.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the design, configuration, development, testing and deployment of OT integrations across DeltaV, Syncade MES, PI Historian and laboratory systems.
* Configure and develop integration services using Ignition, HiveMQ, MQTT, industrial gateways and connectors.
* Define interface specifications, message structures, data mappings and transformations for manufacturing information, including batch, equipment, material and quality data.
* Coordinate the delivery of plant\-side operational applications and visualisation solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, semantic modelling and source\-system teams to ensure consistent and traceable manufacturing data integration.
* Assess existing OT connectivity, integration capabilities and technical constraints across manufacturing systems.
* Develop reusable integration blueprints, engineering standards and implementation patterns for future deployments.
* Apply secure development, version control, testing, release management and monitoring practices appropriate for regulated OT environments.
* Prepare technical specifications and test evidence, supporting CSV/C\&Q activities, hypercare and operational handover.
* Manage technical delivery against agreed project scope, timelines, resources, quality standards and budgets.
* Coordinate external technology providers, system integrators and equipment vendors, ensuring delivery quality and technical compliance.


### About the customer:

Location: Basel, Switzerland (project scope includes Portsmouth, UK) Contract Duration: Until 31 October 2027

One\-Liner

Lead OT integration delivery for a large\-scale manufacturing data platform, connecting automation systems with secure, scalable data solutions.

### Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Control Systems, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience delivering production\-grade OT integrations in industrial or manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Ignition, MQTT, HiveMQ, industrial gateways and message brokers.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing automation systems, including DCS, MES, historians and industrial data platforms.
* Knowledge of ISA\-88, ISA\-95, OT/IT architecture and manufacturing data contextualisation.
* Experience designing APIs, industrial connectors, data interfaces, message models and reusable integration architectures.
* Familiarity with secure deployments, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, version control and change management.
* Understanding of GMP, CSV/CSA and data integrity requirements in regulated environments.
* Proven ability to coordinate technical teams, vendors and external integration partners.
* Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder management and technical delivery skills.
* Business\-fluent English.


Nice to have:

* Advanced experience with DeltaV, Syncade MES and AVEVA PI.
* Previous experience delivering OT integration programmes within pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing.
* Experience supporting validation, qualification and regulatory compliance activities.
* Knowledge of reusable integration architectures for multi\-site manufacturing deployments.
